log_level.description: Logging verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn, error, or off

mode.description: Server operation mode: resolver (recursive), forwarder (recursive with custom upstreams), or cache-only

doh_address.description: IP:port for DoH listener (requires valid TLS credentials when enabled)

doh_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate (PEM format) for DoH

doh_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format) for DoH

dot_address.description: IP:port for DoT listener (requires valid TLS credentials when enabled)

dot_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate (PEM format) for DoT

dot_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format) for DoT

tcp_idle_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds (0 = disable timeout)

udp_max_message_size.description: Maximum UDP message size in bytes (RFC 8467 recommends up to 4096)

upstreams.description: List of upstream DNS resolvers (IP:port or hostname:port) for recursive resolution

recursor_query_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for recursive upstream responses

recursor_max_concurrent_queries.description: Maximum number of simultaneous recursive queries

recursor_validate.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of responses (requires valid trust anchor)

root_ksk_path.description: Path to root key signing key set file (if not using built-in anchor)

zones.description: Static zone definitions (authoritative or slave zones)

axfr_source.description: Source IP for AXFR (zone transfer) requests (optional)

rrld_enabled.description: Enable response rate limiting (RRL) to mitigate DNS amplification attacks

rrld_max_responses.description: Maximum responses allowed per client window before rate limiting kicks in

drop_quietly.description: Drop oversized/malformed packets without sending errors (improves DoS resilience)

server_id.description: Server identifier string (for EDNS client subnet scope and server identification)

soa_mname.description: Primary nameserver hostname for SOA records in authoritative zones
